item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00399","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C06","C25"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 is a concrete and material drafting source for the child. The child follows up on the exact $89,000,000 appropriation request transmitted on July 13, expressly identifying the same Campaign of Truth, information and educational activities, communist propaganda threat, and freedom-versus-slavery rationale. It reuses both distinctive language and the same administrative and legislative machinery while adapting the earlier request into an appeal to senators to restore the full appropriation after a House reduction. C06 and C25 share the broader form of appeals for appropriations or foreign-assistance measures against communism, but neither approaches C02's precise factual, linguistic, and functional correspondence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"On July 13, I transmitted to the Congress an appropriation request for $89,000,000 to carry forward the Campaign of Truth.","parent_excerpt":"I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of the Congress supplemental estimates of appropriation for the fiscal year 1951 in the amount of $89,000,000","explanation":"The child expressly identifies and continues the exact appropriation request made by C02."},{"child_excerpt":"At a time when the Kremlin is sparing no effort to spread the most flagrant lies about this country and our allies, we must forge ahead with this great and affirmative campaign. Truth must prevail throughout the world","parent_excerpt":"The free nations of the world have a great advantage in that truth is on their side. Communist leaders have repeatedly demonstrated that they fear the truth more than any weapon at our command. We must now throw additional resources into a campaign of truth","explanation":"Both use the distinctive Campaign of Truth framing and contrast truth and freedom with communist propaganda."},{"child_excerpt":"I trust that you ... will support the full amount of $89,000,000 necessary for the expansion of our education and information activities.","parent_excerpt":"Our material assistance, to be fully effective, must be complemented by a full-scale effort in the field of ideas.","explanation":"The child converts C02's initial funding submission into a targeted legislative appeal for restoration of the same program and amount."}]}
